mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the tightening signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate a broader economic slowdown.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the labor market weakening signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in retail sales (RSAFS) for two consecutive months signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the weakening demand signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate increased economic activity and corporate profits.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the strengthening supply signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL growth < 1% YoY) signals a stable monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors gain confidence in the economic outlook.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of instances despite the stable inflation signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate increased consumer spending and corporate profits.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the strengthening labor market signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) for two consecutive months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate increased economic activity and corporate profits.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the strengthening housing demand signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings and economic activity.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the weakening GDP signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
